company.name: 安銳智慧股份有限公司

description.text:
Arisan Inc. is looking for PASSIONATE developers to help build enterprise IoT
software services and applications.
安銳在找尋有熱情的程式設計師一起開發企業級的IoT軟體平台及服務。
We work as a team. Your efficiency and growing capabilities will directly impact
company decisions. Join us to shape the future of the industry and bring great products
to our clients.
我們注重緊密的團隊合作。每個開發者的貢獻直接反映到公司及產品。
加入我們一起改變產業的未來！
What you will be doing UNDER GUIDANCE and SUPERVISION:
Responsibilities are released incrementally. Once a developer has proven fluency in
one area then supervision is gradually lifted and more responsibilities may be assigned.
透過工作上的訓練及引導，開發者會逐步接觸、學習並實作下列事項：
‣ Web front end development in JavaScript/TypeScript/HTML/CSS/React.
網路前端開發需要JavaScript/TypeScript/HTML/CSS/React。
‣ Web back end development with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis,
and cloud infrastructures like AWS/Azure/GCP.
網路後端開發需要JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis及各雲端平台
如AWS/Azure/GCP。
‣ Desktop/Mobile application with C++, Qt or React Native
桌機手機應用程式，使用C++, Qt及React Native
‣ DevOps with GitLab, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP, Android Market and iOS App
Store.
DevOps包含利用GitLab, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP及Android市場/iOS軟體商店，
來達到自動部署、自動交付及自動化維運。
‣ Development testing (unit tests, UI tests, integration tests, acceptance tests) and
collaboration with clients.
開發測試包含單元測試、UI測試、整合測試、驗收測試及與客戶溝通。
‣ Software application prototype design, concept proofs, selection of technologies,
implementation, and documentation.
軟體架構設計及驗證。評選採用技術及文件說明紀錄。
What you MUST have for this position:
必要條件：
‣ Strong COMMUNICATION skills
超群溝通能力。能夠把複雜的技術細節簡潔表達。
‣ TEAM-player mentality
與團隊融洽相處。不能只靠單人埋頭苦幹。
‣ PASSION for programming/problem solving
熱愛程式設計及解決問題。
‣ Willingness in LEARNING new tools all the time
願意嘗試、吸收並使用新技術。
‣ Experience in TypeScript or JavaScript
撰寫TypeScript或JavaScript經驗。
What are NICE to have:
加分(不會也沒關係，我們都會教)：
‣ Portfolio of open source projects or personal projects is a plus.
過去的作品、自己開發的小產品或任何對開源軟體的貢獻。
‣ Experience of version control with Git.
利用Git來版本控制。
‣ Knowledge of computer networking and experience with Unix/Linux operation
system.
熟網路架構及Unix/Linux作業系統。
What we PROVIDE:
我們有的：
‣ Quarterly development bonus based on programming velocity.
以開發效率提撥個人季開發獎金。
‣ Small knitted friendly environment. Come see for yourself.
溝通密集開發密集小人數的友善團隊，來看了就知道。
‣ Work from home opportunity.
有條件在家上班。
‣ Clear path for promotion despite for small team.
儘管是小團隊，還是有清楚的升遷制度。
